title: List description shows on the index but not on the list's own page
what_happens: The index card shows name + description. The detail header shows only the name and "2 numbers"; the description only appears as a value inside the Description input at the bottom of the page.
who_hurts: An admin opening a list to check what it is for loses the one line that explains it.
suggested_fix: Render the description under the h1 in the header, as the index does. src/app/admin/lists/[id]/page.tsx:53-58.
